_comment: Test device for development and E2E tests. Copy to test-device.json (gitignored) and fill in your own device. E2E tests run only with SERCOMM_E2E=1 and pytest -m device. gateway = value the E2E IP test leaves on the device, gateway_found = value found before. printer (optional) = the printer the print tests (marker printer, SERCOMM_E2E_PRINTER=1) use: logical_printer 1..3 routed to port, label = text (a plain line plus form feed) or dpl (a one-line Datamax DPL label).
